text.en: When Arc Conductor is active, shots fired have the chance to become chain lightning and return ammo.
When Arc Conductor is active, shots fired have the chance to become chain lightning and return ammo.

While Arc Conductor is active, gain 10% increased damage, 100 Handling, and each shot fired has a 33% chance to fully <title refill [G_refill] /> the magazine.

Scoring 2 to 3 hits within 0.2 seconds of each other causes the target to chain 'weak' lightning to the closest enemy within an 8 meter radius for <pve 19 /> <pvp [?] /> damage.

Enemies hit by this 'weak' lightning release multiple stronger chains of lightning around them, striking up to 4 targets in an 8 meter radius for <pve 22 /> <pvp [?] /> damage.

The stronger chains of lightning only target enemies that haven't been hit by it for 0.33 seconds.
